verdicts.reason: Both lay out the same way. A's product can is larger and keeps its presence as the hero image, while B shrinks it into a small block at the right edge.
These are nearly identical. A's can is a bit bigger and fills the right side better. Both have a cramped footer that is hard to read.
These are almost the same. A's label on the call-to-action button reads a little more clearly and its bottom row of buttons sits less tight. Either one would be acceptable.

B leaves more even spacing and more room at the bottom for the button row, and the can is well proportioned. A packs the footer into the bottom-right corner, right against the edge. B's floating footer looks a bit odd, though.
